name: pmc-define-the-kpis
description: Defines the KPIs for a release with one outcome metric, leading and lagging indicators with definitions and owning teams, a baseline, a target, a guardrail per metric and a review date, in a KPI Definition Sheet. Use for "run pmc-define-the-kpis", "define the KPIs for the new onboarding", "which are leading and which are lagging", "pull the baseline from Amplitude", "what does success look like", "success metrics for this launch", "set a guardrail metric", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
